title: EmbedPolicyRequest
description: The metadata part of `POST /embed-policy`. The document bytes travel as the multipart `file` part; this object is the `metadata` part alongside it.

policy_document_id.description: The `api`-side policy document id, echoed back on every chunk so a response can never be mistaken for another document's.

content_type.description: Media type `api` established by inspecting the bytes — not the type the uploader claimed.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated from `api`, so one request is traceable across all three services (architecture C6).
